description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
Junk Diver dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Thopter and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.
